title: Princess Y72
highlights: Hydraulic bathing platform and Williams tender
description:
An almost-new 2025 Princess Y72 flybridge, used privately and VAT paid, lying in Mandelieu-la-Napoule on the French Riviera. Her design by Pininfarina, Bernard Olesinski and the Princess Design Studio offers features comparable to larger Y Class yachts.

She accommodates eight guests in four cabins plus two crew, and comes with a Seakeeper stabiliser, twin Onan generators, a hardtop, a hydraulic bathing platform, a watermaker and a Williams jet tender.
